Stock market news | PhonePe Revives IPO Plans to Target up to ₹15,000 Crore

PhonePe has resumed its IPO process after putting its listing plans on hold earlier this year. The company is targeting to raise ₹13,000-15,000 crore through an offer for sale.

The company targets ₹13,000-15,000 crore via an offer for sale.
Sources indicate a Q4 FY27 listing at a valuation of $12-15 billion.
